stops.note: the formless void; Hesiod's Theogony says 'first of all Chaos came into being'
the Brussels chemist Jan Baptist van Helmont coined it from chaos, Dutch g sounding like Greek kh; his writings, published in 1648, describe gas from burning charcoal
gas lighting lit London streets from 1807; 'gas' for petrol is short for American 'gasoline'

current_meaning: an air-like substance that expands to fill any space; petrol (US)
